items.title: 英特爾要殺回記憶體！陳立武挖SK海力士前高管 專家：暗示CPU+記憶體堆疊路線
items.title_en: Intel Aims to Revive Memory Business! CEO Pat Gelsinger Hires Former SK Hynix Exec, Experts Say It Hints at CPU+Memory Stacking Roadmap
paras: 英特爾執行長陳立武近期在一場公開對話中表示，該公司正著手研究「新型記憶體架構」，且已經從SK海力士挖角曾任該公司高管的Shil Lee加盟，加碼記憶體技術佈局。他並笑稱，外界「應該能猜到方向」，但細節暫不公開。
在一場播客節目上談到伺服器與資料中心業務時，陳立武坦承「這些年犯了不少錯誤」，但強調英特爾已重新引進頂尖CPU、GPU及系統架構師，同時擴充軟體團隊，目標是在下一輪算力週期中重奪主導地位。
記憶體被陳立武列為最關注的項目。陳立武指出，過去記憶體創新不足、淪為大宗商品，如今新技術湧現，已從大宗料件升級為戰略賽道，尤其是CPU與記憶體之間的堆疊技術，能提供多種整合路徑，成為架構突破關鍵。
他形容科技投資人「每天都能學到新東西」，暗示英特爾的記憶體路線恐跳出傳統DRAM/NVM框架，朝向近記憶體運算或3D堆疊整合推進。
在HBM與AI記憶體被SK海力士、三星主導的當下，英特爾借一位SK海力士前高管重啟架構級探索，信號意義大於產品本身。這家整合元件製造商(IDM)正試圖把「算力+記憶體協同設計」重新拿回自己手裡。
paras_en: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger recently said in a public dialogue that the company is working on a “new memory architecture” and has hired former SK Hynix executive Shil Lee, who previously held a senior role at the Korean chipmaker, to bolster its memory technology efforts. He joked that outsiders “should be able to guess the direction,” but the details are not being disclosed yet.

Speaking on a podcast about the server and data‑center business, Gelsinger admitted that “we’ve made a lot of mistakes over the years,” but stressed that Intel has re‑hired top‑tier CPU, GPU and system architects and is expanding its software teams, aiming to retake the lead in the next compute‑power cycle.

Memory is listed by Gelsinger as his top priority. He noted that memory innovation has lagged in the past, turning it into a commodity, but new technologies are now emerging, elevating memory from a bulk material to a strategic arena—especially the stacking technology between CPUs and memory, which can provide multiple integration pathways and become a key architectural breakthrough.

He described tech investors as “learning something new every day,” hinting that Intel’s memory strategy may break out of the traditional DRAM/NVM framework and move toward near‑memory computing or 3D‑stacked integration.

At a time when HBM and AI‑focused memory are dominated by SK Hynix and Samsung, Intel’s recruitment of a former SK Hynix executive to restart architecture‑level exploration signals a move that matters more than any single product. The integrated device manufacturer is trying to bring “compute‑plus‑memory co‑design” back under its own control.

items.title: 記憶體成本壓力大！谷歌Pixel 11新機漲100美元 容量256GB起步 主打「Gemini Intelligence」
items.title_en: Memory Cost Pressure High! Google Pixel 11 New Machine Rises $100, Starting at $256GB, Mainly Promoting "Gemini Intelligence"
paras: 谷歌周三(12日)在「Made by Google」發表會推出Pixel 11、Pixel 11 Pro、Pixel 11 Pro XL與Pixel 11 Pro Fold四款新機，下周四(20日)正式開賣，分別要價899、1099、1299、1899美元，較上代Pixel 10全系列調漲100美元，漲價主因AI資料中心擠佔DRAM/NAND產能、RAM與快閃記憶體成本飆漲，谷歌設備主管Rick Osterloh更直言，RAM和快閃記憶體短缺正推高整個消費電子業成本。

因此，谷歌用「調結構」弱化漲價痛感：Pixel 11與Pixel 11 Pro砍掉128GB版、改從256GB起跳，兩款機型256GB版本本身未漲，但Pixel 11 Pro XL同容量(12GB/256GB)漲價100美元，且Pro/Pro XL基礎RAM從16GB降至12GB，用戶要回到16GB必須加買512GB或1TB版本。標準版Pixel 11搭載12GB+256GB起、6.3吋螢幕、Tensor G6+Titan M3，端側AI任務最高提速3.5倍。
Pixel 11系列新機主打「Gemini Intelligence」跨40多款App處理多步驟任務，相機新增Magic Capture，Pro系列附6個月Google AI Pro試用、加入HiLight RGB提示燈與Rambler聽寫工具。
事實上，早在6月25日，另一家美國智慧手機大廠蘋果已因「AI資料中心擴張引發記憶體空前短缺」上調MacBook Air(200美元)、MacBook Pro(300美元)、iPad Pro(200美元)等售價。
根據TrendForce數據，今年Q1智慧手機用DRAM合約價格季增88%–93%、NAND漲33%–38%，第二季DRAM再漲58%–63%，DDR5 16GB現貨年內漲幅破6倍，記憶體佔手機物料清單(BPM)比重從10%–15%飆至30%–40%。
Osterloh把AI稱為Pixel對抗iPhone的差異點，甚至預言「AI有一天會成為人們使用手機的主要方式」，但Counterpoint調查數據顯示，AI目前僅排在消費者換機理由第6、7位，仍輸給螢幕、電池、相機。
下周四開賣後，要價899美元起的Pixel 11賣得好不好，將直接回覆「Gemini值不值100美元溢價」這道題目。
paras_en: Google announced the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold at the "Made by Google" event on Wednesday (12th), which will go on sale next Thursday (20th) at $899, $1,099, $1,299, and $1,899 respectively, a $100 increase from the previous generation Pixel 10 series. The main reason for the price increase is the occupation of DRAM/NAND production capacity by AI data centers, as well as the sharp rise in RAM and flash memory costs. Google's hardware director Rick Osterloh even said that the shortage of RAM and flash memory is pushing up the cost of the entire consumer electronics industry.

Therefore, Google used "structural adjustments" to weaken the pain of price increases: Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro dropped the 128GB version and started from 256GB, and the 256GB version of the two machines did not increase in price, but the Pixel 11 Pro XL with the same capacity (12GB/256GB) increased by $100, and the Pro/Pro XL base RAM was reduced from 16GB to 12GB. Users need to buy 512GB or 1TB versions to return to 16GB. The standard Pixel 11 is equipped with 12GB+256GB, 6.3-inch screen, Tensor G6+Titan M3, and the side AI task is accelerated by up to 3.5 times.

The Pixel 11 series new machines mainly promote "Gemini Intelligence" to handle multi-step tasks across 40+ apps, and the camera adds Magic Capture. The Pro series comes with 6 months of Google AI Pro trial, HiLight RGB indicator light, and Rambler handwriting tool.

In fact, as early as June 25th, another US smartphone giant Apple had increased the prices of MacBook Air ($200), MacBook Pro ($300), and iPad Pro ($200) due to "AI data center expansion causing unprecedented memory shortage".

According to TrendForce data, the DRAM contract price for smartphones in Q1 increased by 88%-93% and NAND increased by 33%-38%. In the second quarter, DRAM increased by 58%-63%, and DDR5 16GB increased by over 6 times in a year. The memory share of the smartphone bill of materials (BPM) increased from 10%-15% to 30%-40%.

Osterloh called AI the difference point of Pixel against iPhone, even predicting that "AI will one day become the main way people use their phones". However, Counterpoint's survey data shows that AI is currently ranked 6th and 7th in consumer replacement reasons, still losing to screen, battery, and camera.
After going on sale next Thursday, whether the Pixel 11 priced at $899 will sell well will directly answer the question of "whether Gemini is worth $100 more".

items.title: AI財報亮眼 晶片股逼近牛市！分析師提醒別高興太早？
items.title_en: Chip Stocks on Brink of Bull Market as AI Spending Remains Strong
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，晶片股在企業近期亮眼財報帶動下，再度逼近牛市門檻，但部分分析師提醒，這些財報未必足以支撐市場全面樂觀。
半導體類股周三(12日)表現強勁，SanDisk(SNDK-US)與美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)分別上漲約6%及5%。另一家主要受惠於記憶體晶片需求的SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)，其ADR股價也大漲9%。
AI晶片製造商輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)及超微(Advanced Micro Devices, AMD)(AMD-US)分別上漲3%及2%。
費城半導體指數正逐步踏入牛市，周三收在12,399.38點。根據道瓊斯市場數據，費半必須升至12,536.99點，才能進入新的牛市。一般而言，牛市是指指數自近期低點上漲至少20%。
這波漲勢是在周二盤後CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、美超微電腦(Super Micro Computer)(SMCI-US)及Lumentum(LITE-US)公布財報後出現，這些財報顯示AI支出依然強勁。
投資顧問公司Portfolio Thinking創辦人Dan Kemp表示，這些企業位於AI產業鏈較下游位置，負責連接及安裝晶片以供使用，因此它們的財報讓投資人更直接看到晶片需求的實際情況，進一步支撐市場對半導體產業的樂觀情緒。
Kemp指出，「值得注意的是，支撐這些需求的承諾規模。」他以新興雲端服務商CoreWeave為例。該公司將全年資本支出計畫從原先的310億至350億美元，上調至350億至390億美元，但營收展望「相對溫和得多」。
Kemp指出，CoreWeave還公布第二季淨利息支出6.4億美元，而調整後營業利益僅1.28億美元。「我們還沒有看到足以合理化如此大規模支出承諾的消費者及企業支出。」
CoreWeave與美超微都強調積壓訂單持續增加，後者也重申，截至6月一季的新訂單金額已超過600億美元。
但考量部分訂單最終可能遭到取消或延後，Kemp表示自己仍對這些數字持懷疑態度。
他表示，「投資人有理由將龐大的積壓訂單視為正面訊號，但應該把它視為一系列可能的結果，而不是已經實現的營收。」
他認為，周三晶片股的漲勢也可能與當天稍早公布、整體符合華爾街預期的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告有關。
CoreWeave與美超微股價周三均大漲19%，為資料中心提供光學元件的Lumentum Holdings也上漲超過13%。
不過，Zacks Investment Management首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry表示，這些財報「有助於確認AI交易正在擴大，不只是變得更大」。
他表示，CoreWeave證實GPU需求依然強勁，Lumentum則展現出這項需求如何進一步帶動支撐及運行這些晶片所需的基礎建設。
然而，Mulberry認為，並非所有晶片公司都會以相同程度受惠，因此「基本面最終將更加重要」。他表示，投資人目前尋找的是加速成長，「而不只是單純的股價動能」。
在他看來，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)及光纖網路設備供應商Coherent(COHR-US)擁有最強勁基本面。
Kemp也持類似看法，他認為，對長期投資人而言，關鍵問題在於需求成長速度是否快過股價目前反映的程度。「在這一點上，目前的證據遠沒有那麼令人放心。」
paras_en: Chip stocks are nearing a bull market threshold after a string of strong earnings reports, but some analysts caution that these results may not be enough to sustain a broadly optimistic market.

Semiconductor stocks rallied on Wednesday, with SanDisk (SNDK-US) and Micron Technology (MU-US) rising around 6% and 5%, respectively. SK Hynix (SKHY-US), which benefits from memory chip demand, saw its ADR stock price surge 9%.
Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) rose 3% and 2%, respectively.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index is gradually approaching the bull market threshold, closing at 12,399.38 on Wednesday. According to data from the Dow Jones Market Data, the index must rise to 12,536.99 to enter a new bull market. Generally, a bull market is defined as a 20% increase from recent lows.
The recent rally is attributed to earnings reports from CoreWeave (CRWV-US), Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US), and Lumentum (LITE-US) on Tuesday, which showed strong AI spending.

Dan Kemp, founder of Portfolio Thinking, notes that these companies are located in the lower end of the AI industry chain, responsible for connecting and installing chips for use. Their earnings reports provide a more direct view of chip demand, further supporting the market's optimistic sentiment towards the semiconductor industry.

Kemp points out that "what's worth noting is the commitment scale supporting these demands." He uses CoreWeave as an example, which increased its full-year capital expenditure plan from $31 billion to $39 billion, but its revenue outlook is "relatively mild."

Kemp notes that CoreWeave also reported second-quarter net interest expense of $64 million, with adjusted operating income of $128 million. "We haven't seen enough evidence to justify such a large-scale commitment of spending," he says.
CoreWeave and Super Micro both emphasized that backlog orders continue to increase, with the latter reiterating that new orders exceeding $6 billion as of June quarter.
However, considering that some orders may ultimately be canceled or delayed, Kemp remains skeptical about these numbers.
He notes that "investors have reason to view massive backlog orders as a positive signal, but they should view it as a series of possible outcomes rather than realized revenue."
He believes that Wednesday's chip stock rally may also be related to the earlier-than-expected release of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which met Wall Street expectations.
CoreWeave and Super Micro stock prices both surged 19% on Wednesday, with Lumentum Holdings rising over 13%.
However, Zacks Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Brian Mulberry notes that these earnings reports "help confirm that AI trading is expanding, not just getting bigger."
He notes that CoreWeave's earnings confirmed strong GPU demand, while Lumentum showed how this demand drives further investment in the infrastructure needed to support and run these chips.

However, Mulberry believes that not all chip companies will benefit equally, and "the fundamental picture will ultimately become more important." He notes that investors are currently seeking accelerated growth, "not just simple stock price momentum."
In his view, Nvidia (NVDA-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US), and Coherent (COHR-US) have the strongest fundamentals.

Kemp also shares this view, noting that the key issue for long-term investors is whether demand growth is outpacing the current stock price reflection. "At this point, the evidence is far from reassuring."

items.title: 馬斯克Grok 4.6亮相！性能追平GPT-5.6 Sol、API價格砍半
items.title_en: Musk's Grok 4.6 Debuts with Performance Matching GPT-5.6 Sol, API Price Cut in Half
paras: 馬斯克旗下SpaceXAI(原xAI)周三(12日)正式推出新一代旗艦模型Grok 4.6, 將主要升級方向鎖定長時間運行的AI代理(Agent)、複雜程式設計、知識工作及互動與視覺任務。SpaceXAI表示, Grok 4.6在多項前沿模型測試中已進入第一梯隊, 同時以每100萬個輸入Token 2美元、輸出Token 6美元的價格切入市場, 約為部分競爭對手的一半, 企圖以「高性能+低成本」策略搶攻開發者市場。
SpaceXAI在官方公告中表示, Grok 4.6是在Grok 4.5基礎上進一步強化, 特別針對長時間運行的Agent及更具挑戰性的互動、視覺工作。新模型可以處理需要多步驟執行的研究工作、程式碼庫分析及應用程式開發, 並在更長的任務過程中進行自主測試與驗證, 讓模型不只是回答問題, 而是能持續完成一項完整工作。
SpaceXAI指出, Grok 4.6接受比Grok 4.5更長的補充訓練, 訓練資料包括經過篩選的模型生成推理資料及高品質工程資料, 同時改進最佳化器與訓練方法。公司並利用Grok 4.5生成不同推理強度、Agent框架以及STEM、軟體工程和知識工作等領域的SFT軌跡, 再透過強化學習訓練Grok 4.6執行通用程式設計、知識工作、核心程式最佳化、網頁開發及電腦輔助設計等任務。
這次升級最受市場關注的之一, 是Grok 4.6在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index取得61分, 與OpenAI的GPT-5.6 Sol並列。Artificial Analysis指出, 該指數綜合多項測試, 用來評估模型在數學、科學、程式設計與推理等不同能力的整體表現。Grok 4.6因此進一步縮小與頂級模型之間的性能差距。
在GDPVal-AA v2測試中, Grok 4.6則取得1,753 Elo, 高於GPT-5.6 Sol的1,728分及Anthropic旗下Claude Fable 5的1,741分。這項測試著重於具有實際經濟價值的專業工作, 包括不同職業與產業的知識工作任務, 更接近企業實際導入AI代理後可能面對的工作場景。

不過, Grok 4.6並非在所有評測中都取得第一。SpaceXAI公布的其他測試顯示, 新模型在CursorBench v3.2取得69.9%, 高於Grok 4.5 High的66.7%; FrontierCode v1.1達61.3%, 高於前代56.6%; APEX-Agents達57.5%, 高於前代47.1%; APEX-SWE為56.4%, 高於前代53.6%; AA-Briefcase則由前代1,313分提升至1,577分; Harvey LAB也由12.9%提高至15.8%。
在部分測試中, 競爭對手仍然領先, 因此較準確的說法是Grok 4.6已在多項Agent、程式設計及知識工作測試進入頂級模型行列, 而非全面擊敗所有競爭模型。Artificial Analysis的排名也會隨模型新增與測試更新而變動, 因此SpaceXAI公布的排名主要反映發布時點的橫向比較。
除了模型性能, Grok 4.6的價格策略更可能成為AI產業下一階段競爭的焦點。SpaceXAI將標準API價格設定為每100萬個輸入Token 2美元、每100萬個輸出Token 6美元, 並提供速度更快、價格約為兩倍的版本。公司宣稱, 標準版本價格約為其他前沿模型的一半。
這項定價策略將Grok 4.6直接推向開發者及企業AI市場。相較之下, 市場目前對前沿模型的競爭已逐漸從單純比拚基準測試, 延伸到每次推理成本、Token效率、速度以及能否完成實際工作的能力。當模型性能逐漸接近時, 相同工作究竟需要多少運算成本, 很可能成為企業選擇模型的重要因素。
不過, API單價並不代表所有任務的最終成本都會同比下降。不同模型的Token消耗、推理強度、任務執行時間以及Agent需要呼叫多少次工具, 都會影響實際使用成本。因此, Grok 4.6的「半價」主要是API標價上的比較, 並不意味著所有應用場景的總成本都一定低50%。
SpaceXAI也同步擴大Grok 4.6的開發者通路。新模型已提供給Cursor、Grok Build及API使用, 並透過OpenRouter、Vercel及Cloudflare(NET-US)等平台與服務商提供。SpaceXAI表示, 上線首周Cursor與Grok Build用戶可獲得2倍包含用量, 讓開發者能以更低門檻測試新模型。
這也延續SpaceXAI近幾個月積極搶攻AI程式開發市場的策略。公司7月推出Grok Build開源版本, 將旗下程式設計Agent的核心框架公開, 包括上下文組裝、工具調用、程式碼讀取與修改、命令執行、技能、插件及子Agent等功能, 並允許開發者在本地環境運行。
Grok Build原先已被SpaceXAI定位為面向專業軟體工程與複雜程式設計工作的Coding Agent, 使用者可以先讓模型規劃工作, 再審核與批准執行計畫, 每次程式碼修改也會以差異檔案方式呈現。Grok 4.6此次進一步強化Agent能力, 等於為這套開發工具提供更強大的模型引擎。
SpaceXAI此次還特別強調, Grok 4.6在「把想法變成產品」方面有明顯提升。面對一個模糊的產品概念, 模型可以先研究陌生領域, 設計應用架構, 建立核心功能, 再根據測試結果及使用者回饋進行多輪修改。在視覺及互動式專案中, 新模型也能更快產出完整的第一版成果。
這種能力反映AI模型競爭正從「問答」走向「執行」。過去大模型主要以回答問題、生成文字或程式碼作為能力展示, 現在OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及SpaceXAI等業者都逐步把Agent能力視為下一個競爭戰場, 希望模型能自行使用工具、拆解任務、修改成果並完成長時間工作。
Grok 4.6在GDPVal-AA v2的表現尤其符合這項趨勢。SpaceXAI公布的1,753 Elo不只是一般知識問答成績, 而是來自需要模型在Agent環境中完成實際專業工作的測試, 因此公司試圖藉此證明新模型不只是「聊天能力」提升, 而是已能處理更接近企業工作流程的任務。
馬斯克也迅速在社群平台X為新模型造勢。他轉發Grok 4.6取得1,753 Elo及在多項測試領先的相關內容, 並對新模型作出高度評價。這也是馬斯克近期持續親自推廣Grok產品的最新例子。
從產業競爭角度來看, Grok 4.6的推出時間也值得注意。Grok 4.5才在7月16日發布, SpaceXAI不到一個月便推出下一代版本。Grok 4.5當時已將程式設計、Agent任務及知識工作列為主要能力, 並強調與Cursor共同訓練, 顯示SpaceXAI正在快速縮短模型迭代週期。
SpaceXAI近期也持續把Grok從聊天機器人擴展為完整AI工作平台。7月推出的Automations功能允許使用者設定一次工作, 之後讓Grok按照排程或收到電子郵件等觸發條件自行執行, 並回報結果; 5月推出的Connectors則讓Grok直接連接企業及個人使用的應用程式, 執行讀取電子郵件、整理文件、更新簡報、管理行事曆及編輯試算表等工作。
因此, Grok 4.6的真正戰略意義可能不只是與GPT或Claude比拚排行榜, 而是SpaceXAI正試圖建立從模型、Agent、Coding工具到第三方開發平台的完整生態系。若低API價格能夠吸引大量開發者, 再透過Cursor、Grok Build、OpenRouter及雲端平台擴大使用, SpaceXAI便有機會在模型之外取得更大的開發者入口。
不過, 低價策略也代表SpaceXAI必須承擔更高的運算成本壓力。前沿模型的訓練與推理都需要大量GPU及資料中心資源, 若模型價格持續下探, AI業者必須依靠更高的使用量、更高的Token效率或其他商業模式來支撐毛利率。這也意味著Grok 4.6的價格戰不只是爭取市占率, 同時也是對SpaceXAI基礎設施效率的一項考驗。
對開發者而言, Grok 4.6的吸引力則在於它同時提供前沿級性能與相對低廉的API價格。若其在實際工作中的Token效率及任務完成率能夠維持目前的測試表現, 開發者可能更願意把Grok納入程式設計、研究、資料分析及企業Agent工作流。
而對OpenAI與Anthropic等競爭對手而言, Grok 4.6也進一步加劇前沿模型價格壓力。當新模型在部分專業工作測試中已能取得領先, 同時API價格又明顯較低, 市場競爭就不再只是誰的模型最聰明, 而是誰能以最低成本完成最多工作。
目前Grok 4.6已經可以透過API以及部分開發者平台使用, 但不同平台的可用方式與方案可能有所差異。SpaceXAI此次發布的重點也主要放在開發者與Agent應用, 而非單純消費者聊天產品的更新。

整體而言, Grok 4.6顯示SpaceXAI正在把AI競賽的戰場從單一模型性能, 推向長時間Agent執行能力、程式設計、知識工作及推理成本。61分的Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index與1,753 Elo的GDPVal-AA v2成績, 讓Grok進一步站上前沿模型競爭舞台; 每100萬Token輸入2美元、輸出6美元的價格, 則是SpaceXAI試圖擴大市場滲透率的另一張王牌。
隨著模型能力差距逐漸縮小, AI產業下一階段的勝負關鍵可能從「誰擁有最高分」轉向「誰能以更低成本完成更多工作」。Grok 4.6此次同時押注性能與價格, 能否真正轉化為開發者使用量與企業採用, 將決定這場AI模型價格戰究竟只是一次產品攻勢, 還是成為SpaceXAI搶進前沿AI市場的重要轉折點。
paras_en: Elon Musk's SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) officially launched its new flagship model, Grok 4.6, on Wednesday, focusing on long-running AI agents, complex programming, knowledge work, and interactive and visual tasks. SpaceXAI stated that Grok 4.6 has entered the top tier in multiple cutting-edge model tests, with a market entry price of $2 per 1 million input tokens and $6 per 1 million output tokens, approximately half of some competitors' prices, aiming to capture the developer market with a 'high-performance + low-cost' strategy.

SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is an enhancement of Grok 4.5, particularly for long-running agents and more challenging interactive and visual tasks. The new model can handle research tasks, codebase analysis, and application development that require multiple steps, and can perform autonomous testing and validation over longer task processes, enabling the model to not only answer questions but also complete a whole task.

SpaceXAI pointed out that Grok 4.6 has undergone longer supplemental training than Grok 4.5, with training data including filtered model-generated reasoning data and high-quality engineering data, and has improved optimizers and training methods. The company used Grok 4.5 to generate different reasoning strengths, agent frameworks, and SFT trajectories in STEM, software engineering, and knowledge work, and then trained Grok 4.6 using reinforcement learning to perform general programming, knowledge work, core program optimization, web development, and computer-aided design tasks.

One of the most closely watched upgrades is Grok 4.6's score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, tied with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol. Artificial Analysis stated that the index combines multiple tests to evaluate a model's overall performance in mathematics, science, programming, and reasoning. Grok 4.6 has thus further narrowed the performance gap with top models.

In the GDPVal-AA v2 test, Grok 4.6 scored 1,753 Elo, higher than GPT-5.6 Sol's 1,728 and Anthropic's Claude Fable 5's 1,741. This test focuses on professional tasks with practical economic value, including knowledge work tasks in various professions and industries, which is closer to the work scenarios that enterprises may face when introducing AI agents.

However, Grok 4.6 did not rank first in all evaluations. Other tests released by SpaceXAI show that the new model scored 69.9% on CursorBench v3.2, higher than Grok 4.5 High's 66.7%; 61.3% on FrontierCode v1.1, higher than the previous generation's 56.6%; 57.5% on APEX-Agents, higher than the previous generation's 47.1%; 56.4% on APEX-SWE, higher than the previous generation's 53.6%; and 1,577 on AA-Briefcase, up from the previous generation's 1,313. Harvey LAB also increased from 12.9% to 15.8%.

In some tests, competitors still lead, so it is more accurate to say that Grok 4.6 has entered the top tier in multiple agent, programming, and knowledge work tests, rather than comprehensively defeating all competing models. Artificial Analysis's rankings will also change with the addition of new models and updates, so SpaceXAI's released rankings mainly reflect the horizontal comparison at the time of release.

In addition to model performance, Grok 4.6's pricing strategy is likely to become the focus of competition in the AI industry. SpaceXAI set the standard API price at $2 per 1 million input tokens and $6 per 1 million output tokens, and offers a faster, more expensive version. The company claims that the standard version is approximately half the price of other cutting-edge models.

This pricing strategy directly targets the developer and enterprise AI markets. In contrast, the current competition for cutting-edge models has gradually shifted from simply comparing benchmark tests to the cost of each inference, token efficiency, speed, and the ability to complete actual work. As model performance approaches each other, the operating cost required for the same work may become an important factor for enterprises to choose models.

However, the API unit price does not mean that the final cost of all tasks will decrease by the same proportion. The token consumption, reasoning strength, task execution time, and the number of times an agent needs to call tools will affect the actual usage cost. Therefore, Grok 4.6's 'half-price' is mainly a comparison of API pricing and does not mean that the total cost of all application scenarios will definitely be 50% lower.

SpaceXAI is also expanding Grok 4.6's developer channels. The new model is already available for use through Cursor, Grok Build, and API, and is provided to platform and service providers such as OpenRouter, Vercel, and Cloudflare (NET-US). SpaceXAI stated that users of Cursor and Grok Build can receive double the included usage in the first week, allowing developers to test the new model at a lower threshold.

This continues SpaceXAI's strategy of aggressively capturing the AI programming market in recent months. In July, the company released the open-source version of Grok Build, making the core framework of its programming design agent public, including context assembly, tool invocation, code reading and modification, command execution, skills, plugins, and sub-agents, and allowing developers to run it in a local environment.

Grok Build was originally positioned by SpaceXAI as a coding agent for professional software engineering and complex programming tasks. Users can let the model plan the work, review and approve the plan, and modify the code, with each modification presented as a diff file. Grok 4.6 further strengthens the agent's capabilities, providing a more powerful model engine for this development tool.

SpaceXAI also emphasized that Grok 4.6 has significantly improved its ability to 'turn ideas into products'. When faced with a vague product concept, the model can research unfamiliar fields, design application architectures, establish core functions, and modify them based on test results and user feedback. In visual and interactive projects, the new model can also produce a complete first draft faster.

This ability reflects the shift in AI model competition from 'Q&A' to 'execution'. In the past, large models mainly demonstrated their capabilities by answering questions, generating text, or code. Now, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and SpaceXAI are gradually regarding agent capabilities as the next competitive battlefield, hoping that models can use tools, break down tasks, modify results, and complete long-term work on their own.

Grok 4.6's performance in GDPVal-AA v2 is particularly in line with this trend. SpaceXAI's released 1,753 Elo is not only a general knowledge Q&A score but also comes from tests that require the model to complete actual professional tasks in an agent environment. The company is trying to prove that the new model is not only improved in 'chatting ability' but also capable of handling tasks closer to enterprise workflows.

Musk also quickly promoted the new model on the social platform X. He forwarded related content about Grok 4.6's 1,753 Elo and its lead in multiple tests, and gave high praise to the new model. This is also the latest example of Musk personally promoting Grok products in recent times.

From an industry competition perspective, the timing of Grok 4.6's release is also noteworthy. Grok 4.5 was released on July 16, and SpaceXAI released the next-generation version in less than a month. Grok 4.5 had already positioned programming, agent tasks, and knowledge work as its main capabilities and emphasized its joint training with Cursor, showing that SpaceXAI is shortening the model iteration cycle.

SpaceXAI has also been continuously expanding Grok from a chatbot to a complete AI work platform. The Automations feature released in July allows users to set up a task and let Grok execute it according to a schedule or trigger conditions and report the results. The Connectors released in May allow Grok to directly connect to enterprise and personal applications, performing tasks such as reading emails, organizing files, updating presentations, managing calendars, and editing spreadsheets.

Therefore, the true strategic significance of Grok 4.6 may not only be competing with GPT or Claude in rankings but also SpaceXAI's attempt to establish a complete ecosystem from models, agents, coding tools to third-party development platforms. If the low API price can attract a large number of developers and expand usage through Cursor, Grok Build, OpenRouter, and cloud platforms, SpaceXAI may have the opportunity to gain a larger developer entry point beyond models.

However, the low-price strategy also means that SpaceXAI must bear higher computational cost pressure. The training and inference of cutting-edge models require a large amount of GPU and data center resources. If model prices continue to decline, AI companies must rely on higher usage, higher token efficiency, or other business models to support profit margins. This also means that Grok 4.6's price war is not only a competition for market share but also a test of SpaceXAI's infrastructure efficiency.

For developers, Grok 4.6's appeal lies in its simultaneous provision of cutting-edge performance and relatively low API prices. If its token efficiency and task completion rate in actual work can maintain the current test performance, developers may be more willing to incorporate Grok into programming, research, data analysis, and enterprise agent workflows.

For competitors like OpenAI and Anthropic, Grok 4.6 further increases the price pressure on cutting-edge models. When a new model has already taken the lead in some professional work tests and its API price is significantly lower, market competition is no longer just about whose model is the smartest, but also about who can complete the most work at the lowest cost.

Currently, Grok 4.6 is available for use through API and some developer platforms, but the availability and plans on different platforms may vary. SpaceXAI's focus in this release is mainly on developer and agent applications, rather than updates to single consumer chat products.

Overall, Grok 4.6 shows that SpaceXAI is shifting the AI competition battlefield from single-model performance to long-term agent execution capabilities, programming, knowledge work, and reasoning costs. The 61-score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and the 1,753 Elo on GDPVal-AA v2 have allowed Grok to further stand on the cutting-edge model competition stage; the price of $2 per 1 million input tokens and $6 per 1 million output tokens is another trump card for SpaceXAI to expand its market penetration.

As the model capability gap narrows, the key to winning in the AI industry may shift from 'who has the highest score' to 'who can complete more work at a lower cost'. Grok 4.6's bet on both performance and price may be able to translate into developer usage and enterprise adoption, which will determine whether this AI model price war is just a product offensive or a significant turning point for SpaceXAI to advance into the cutting-edge AI market.

items.title: AI競賽告急！谷歌共同創辦人布林下場督戰 DeepMind大重組 加速衝刺Gemini
items.title_en: AI Competition in Crisis! Google Co-Founder Brin Steps Down to Cheer on DeepMind's Major Overhaul to Accelerate Gemini
paras: 外媒引述知情人士最新報導指出，谷歌母公司Alphabet正力圖縮小與競爭對手在AI的差距，因共同創辦人Sergey Brin近幾個月敦促公司重要AI團隊全力投入Gemini模型研發。
一位匿名知情人士透露，今年4月Anthropic憑藉強大的Claude Mythos模型預覽版取得領先之際，Brin在一場數百名員工參加的內部大會發表談話，要求DeepMind人工智慧實驗室加快開發進度。
去年11月，Gemini模型曾短暫超越競爭對手，但Anthropic與OpenAI隨後推出的新版本模型，再度讓谷歌處於追趕狀態。
兩位知情人士指出，到今年8月，由於內部測試顯示Gemini在程序編碼等領域表現仍落後競爭對手，谷歌將新一代旗艦版Gemini推遲兩個月推出。
上周三(5日)，谷歌宣布全面改組DeepMind人工智慧部門領導層，該部門負責人Demis Hassabis卸下主管職務，由其副手Koray Kavukcuoglu接任，Hassabis則轉任董事長，管理權責縮減。同時，Gemini最初的兩位技術聯合負責人辭職，共同創辦一家新創公司。
儘管一些產業觀察人士質疑谷歌是否正退出大型模型競賽，但根據外媒對7名了解Gemini開發情況人士的訪問顯示，Alphabet的商業化戰略及上周三的人事重組，都與爭奪模型主導地位的努力密切相關。
paras_en: According to a recent report by a source familiar with the matter, Alphabet, the parent company of Google, is making a concerted effort to narrow the gap with its competitors in the AI field, as co-founder Sergey Brin has been urging the company's key AI teams to focus on developing the Gemini model over the past few months.

A source close to the matter revealed that in April, Anthropic took the lead with its powerful Claude Mythos model preview, prompting Brin to deliver a speech at an internal conference attended by hundreds of employees, urging DeepMind's artificial intelligence laboratory to accelerate its development pace.
Last November, the Gemini model briefly surpassed its competitors, but Anthropic and OpenAI's subsequent release of new versions of their models put Google back in a catch-up position.

Two sources pointed out that by August, due to internal testing showing that Gemini still lagged behind its competitors in areas such as programming, Google delayed the release of its next-generation flagship Gemini model by two months.

Last Wednesday (5th), Google announced a comprehensive overhaul of the leadership team at DeepMind's artificial intelligence department, with Demis Hassabis stepping down as head of the department and being replaced by his deputy Koray Kavukcuoglu, while Hassabis took on the role of chairman and saw his responsibilities reduced. At the same time, the two original technical co-leaders of Gemini resigned and co-founded a new startup.

Despite some industry observers questioning whether Google is withdrawing from the competition for large-scale models, according to media reports based on interviews with seven people familiar with the Gemini development process, Alphabet's commercial strategy and last Wednesday's personnel reshuffle are closely related to the efforts to dominate the model market.

items.title: 白銀多頭列車要加速！花旗喊上看90美元 潛在漲幅近4成
items.title_en: Silver Bull Train Must Accelerate! Citi Forecasts Up to $90, Potential Gain Near 40%
paras: 花旗最新重申對白銀的看多立場，預估隨著投資買盤接棒成為主要推力，銀價未來 3 個月可望升至每盎司 75 美元，未來 6 至 12 個月更可能挑戰 90 美元，較目前約 65 美元的現貨價格上漲約 38%。
花旗認為，白銀接下來的漲勢將不再主要仰賴工業用途，而是由資金流向主導。隨著荷姆茲海峽緊張局勢最終可望降溫，加上聯準會政策立場可能轉趨溫和，先前壓抑貴金屬的美元走強與實質利率上升等因素有望逐步消退，帶動白銀投資需求持續回升。
由於白銀通常與黃金同向波動，但價格彈性更高。
花旗形容，若荷姆茲海峽僵局迅速化解，白銀將成為押注貴金屬上漲的理想標的。該行基本情境預估，中東局勢最快可能在今年 9 月至 12 月間緩和，屆時白銀有望以更大幅度跟進金價上漲。
另一方面，白銀的工業需求前景開始出現結構性變化。太陽能業者持續減少單位電池的白銀用量，並加快採用背接觸式 (BC) 電池技術，可能使太陽能產業對白銀的需求成長放緩。花旗預估，BC 技術最快可於 2028 年成為太陽能市場的主流技術之一。
不過，人工智慧 (AI)、5G及電動車產業對白銀的需求仍具韌性，花旗預期全球白銀市場至少到 2027 年都將維持供不應求，為銀價提供中長期支撐。
印度市場也是另一項利多。目前印度國內銀價較國際價格溢價約 7%，反映當地買盤強勁。隨著第四季節慶及婚禮旺季到來，印度白銀需求可望進一步升溫。
paras_en: Citi reiterated its bullish stance on silver, estimating that with investment buying taking over as the main driver, the price could rise to $75 per ounce within the next three months and potentially challenge $90 within six to twelve months – about a 38% increase from the current spot price of roughly $65.

Citi believes the upcoming rally in silver will be driven less by industrial use and more by capital flows. As tensions in the Hormuz Strait are expected to ease and the Fed’s policy stance may become more dovish, the previously suppressive factors for precious metals—such as a strong dollar and rising real rates—should gradually recede, reviving investment demand for silver.
Silver typically moves in tandem with gold, but its price is more elastic.

Citi described that if the Hormuz Strait deadlock is resolved quickly, silver would become an ideal vehicle for betting on a rise in precious metals. The bank’s baseline scenario projects that the Middle‑East situation could ease as early as September to December this year, at which point silver is likely to follow gold’s gains with an even larger jump.

On the other hand, the outlook for silver’s industrial demand is beginning to shift structurally. Solar manufacturers are continuously reducing the amount of silver per cell and accelerating the adoption of back‑contact (BC) cell technology, which could slow the growth of silver demand from the solar sector. Citi estimates that BC technology could become one of the mainstream solar technologies as early as 2028.

Nevertheless, demand for silver from AI, 5G and electric‑vehicle industries remains resilient. Citi expects the global silver market to stay in deficit at least through 2027, providing medium‑ to long‑term support for prices.

India also offers a tailwind. Domestic silver prices in India carry a premium of about 7% over international levels, reflecting strong local buying. With the fourth‑quarter festive season and wedding rush approaching, Indian silver demand is expected to heat up further.

items.title: Anthropic傳砸60億美元買Decart 史上最大收購補強AI算力
items.title_en: Anthropic Spends $6 Billion to Acquire Decart in Largest Acquisition to Date
paras: 彭博引述消息人士報導，Anthropic正洽購同業 Decart AI，交易金額約達 60 億美元，若最終完成，將創下Anthropic迄今規模最大的收購紀錄，也正值其備受市場矚目的IPO前夕。
向來極少進行大型併購的 Anthropic，為了開發新產品與服務客戶，近年持續在算力上投入重金。
消息人士表示，Decart 的軟體能使晶片運作更具效率，進而降低訓練人工智慧模型的成本。這項技術有助於 Anthropic 現有基礎設施承載更龐大的需求。交易完成後，Decart 的團隊將加入 Anthropic 的推論與效能部門。
Decart 同時專注於生成式影片技術，利用所謂的「世界模型」（world models），即時修改直播影像。消息人士指出，這項技術也反映 Decart 擁有高水準的基礎設施技術人才。
Anthropic 與 Decart 的代表均拒絕置評。
Decart 今年 5 月表示，公司在由 Radical Ventures 領投的一輪融資中籌得 3 億美元，輝達(NVDA-US) 、Atreides Management、Valor Equity Partners 與 Adobe Ventures 也參與投資。既有投資人紅杉資本、Benchmark 與 Zeev Ventures 同樣參與本輪融資。
據《華爾街日報》報導，該輪融資對這家新創公司的估值逼近 40 億美元，高於 2025 年 8 月時的 31 億美元。
Decart 成立於 2023 年，由三名以色列工程師共同創辦，分別是兄弟 Dean Leitersdorf、Orian Leitersdorf，以及 Moshe Shalev。
OpenAI 與 Anthropic 都已承諾投入數百億、甚至數千億美元，興建配置昂貴晶片的資料中心。隨著運算需求急速攀升，兩家公司也愈來愈依賴不同供應商提供的硬體，以滿足龐大的算力需求。
隨著這兩家 AI 新創公司準備在未來幾個月內迎來華爾街首秀，這些被其高層認為是打造與支援尖端人工智慧模型不可或缺的龐大支出，也可能為其帶來財務壓力。
本篇不開放合作媒體轉載
paras_en: Bloomberg reported that Anthropic is in talks to acquire Decart AI, with a deal valued at around $6 billion, which would be the company's largest acquisition to date, coming at a time when it is preparing for its highly anticipated IPO.
Anthropic, which has historically been reluctant to make large acquisitions, has been investing heavily in computing power in recent years to develop new products and serve its customers.

According to sources, Decart's software enables chips to operate more efficiently, reducing the cost of training artificial intelligence models. This technology will help Anthropic's existing infrastructure handle larger demands.

Decart has also focused on generative video technology, using so-called 'world models' to modify live video in real-time. Sources say this technology reflects Decart's high level of infrastructure technology talent.
Representatives from Anthropic and Decart declined to comment.

Decart announced in May that it had raised $300 million in a funding round led by Radical Ventures, with NVIDIA (NVDA-US), Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, and Adobe Ventures also participating. Existing investors Redpoint Ventures, Benchmark, and Zeev Ventures also participated in the round.
According to a report by The Wall Street Journal, the funding round valued the company at around $4 billion, higher than its $3.1 billion valuation in August 2025.
Decart was founded in 2023 by three Israeli engineers, Dean Leitersdorf, Orian Leitersdorf, and Moshe Shalev.

Both OpenAI and Anthropic have committed to investing hundreds of billions, if not trillions, of dollars in building data centers equipped with expensive chips. As computing demands have skyrocketed, both companies have increasingly relied on hardware suppliers to meet their massive computing needs.

As these two AI startups prepare to go public on Wall Street in the coming months, these massive expenditures, which their executives believe are essential for building and supporting cutting-edge AI models, may also bring financial pressure.
This article is not available for media republishing.

items.title: 硬體股大幅跑贏標普500！高盛最看好這三家公司
items.title_en: Hardware Stocks Outperform the S&P 500! Goldman Sachs’ Top Three Picks
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 基礎建設投資持續升溫，高盛最新點名戴爾科技、慧與科技及NetApp為美國硬體產業三大首選股。高盛認為，AI伺服器需求快速成長，加上企業加速更新資料中心設備，可望繼續推升硬體業者營收與獲利。
美國硬體股今年第二季以來明顯跑贏大盤。高盛統計，4月1日至8月7日期間，標普500指數上漲18%，IT硬體類股上漲136%，戴爾科技、慧與科技與NetApp的漲幅則分別達168%、122%及86%。
高盛維持三家公司「買進」評等，但依據最新營運展望分別調整目標價，其中戴爾科技仍是首選。
戴爾科技：AI與傳統伺服器需求同步成長
高盛維持戴爾科技 (DELL-US)「買進」評等，並將12個月目標價由500美元調高至510美元。除了AI伺服器需求強勁，傳統伺服器業務展望改善，也是高盛上調財測的主要原因。
高盛預估，戴爾2027會計年度第二季營收將達448億美元，其中基礎設施解決方案事業群營收可望年增75%，用戶端解決方案事業群也將成長20%。調整後每股盈餘預估為4.96美元，高於公司財測區間上緣。
基於傳統伺服器營收預期上修，高盛將戴爾2027至2029會計年度每股盈餘預測平均調高4%。戴爾近期也推出搭載輝達 (NVDA-US) Vera Rubin架構的PowerEdge XE8812伺服器，進一步強化AI硬體產品布局。
不過，高盛提醒，個人電腦需求轉弱、企業IT支出放緩、同業價格競爭、零組件成本上升，以及白牌伺服器業者搶占市占率，可能對戴爾的成長與利潤率造成壓力。
慧與科技：網路設備成為另一成長引擎
高盛同樣維持慧與科技 (HPE-US)「買進」評等，但將12個月目標價由79美元下修至75美元。
高盛預估，慧與科技2026會計年度第三季營收將達120億美元，高於市場共識，其中雲端與AI業務營收可望年增22%，網路業務更可能大增77%。調整後每股盈餘預估為0.94美元，略高於公司財測區間上緣。
隨著超大規模雲端服務商擴建AI基礎設施，加上一般用途運算需求加速回升，高盛將慧與科技2026至2028會計年度每股盈餘預估平均上調2%，主要反映網路設備營收展望改善。
慧與科技近期獲得雲端服務商Vultr選用，參與大規模AI資料中心部署，並把Juniper Networks網路產品整合至AI資料中心解決方案，同時與8家公司擴大在量子運算領域的合作。
潛在風險則包括企業IT支出下滑、白牌設備競爭、整合Juniper期間流失市占率，以及零組件成本上升。
NetApp：企業儲存設備售價支撐成長
高盛維持資料儲存業者NetApp (NTAP-US)「買進」評等，並將12個月目標價由200美元調高至210美元，主要看好企業基礎設施支出，以及儲存設備平均售價上升。
高盛預估，NetApp 2027會計年度第一季營收將達18.1億美元，每股盈餘為2.12美元，略高於公司財測中間值。基於儲存設備平均售價提高，高盛將2027至2029會計年度營收與每股盈餘預測分別平均上調5%及4%。
NetApp上一季營收與獲利均優於市場預期，帶動Argus與巴克萊等機構調高目標價。公司近期也宣布收購AI資料基礎設施業者DataPelago，以擴充AI資料管理能力。
高盛提醒，NetApp仍可能面臨供應短缺、企業本地部署儲存設備需求長期下滑、產業競爭加劇，以及全球總體經濟轉弱等風險。
paras_en: Artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure investment continues to heat up, and Goldman Sachs has recently highlighted Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and NetApp as the three top U.S. hardware stocks. Goldman Sachs believes that rapid growth in AI server demand, combined with enterprises accelerating data‑center upgrades, should keep driving revenue and profit growth for hardware makers.

U.S. hardware stocks have clearly outperformed the broader market since the second quarter of this year. Goldman Sachs calculated that from April 1 to August 7, the S&P 500 rose 18%, while IT hardware stocks jumped 136%, with Dell Technologies, Hewlett Packard Enterprise and NetApp gaining 168%, 122% and 86% respectively.
Goldman Sachs maintains a “Buy” rating on all three companies but has adjusted their target prices based on the latest operating outlook, keeping Dell Technologies as the top pick.
Dell Technologies: AI and Traditional Server Demand Growing Together

Goldman Sachs keeps a “Buy” rating on Dell Technologies (DELL‑US) and raises its 12‑month target price from $500 to $510. In addition to strong AI server demand, an improving outlook for the traditional server business is the main reason for the upgraded financial forecasts.

Goldman Sachs estimates that Dell’s fiscal 2027 second‑quarter revenue will reach $44.8 billion, with the infrastructure solutions segment expected to grow 75% year‑over‑year and the client solutions segment to expand 20%. Adjusted earnings per share are projected at $4.96, above the upper end of the company’s own guidance range.

Based on the upward revision to traditional server revenue, Goldman Sachs lifts its average EPS forecast for Dell for fiscal 2027‑2029 by 4%. Dell recently introduced the PowerEdge XE8812 server built on Nvidia’s (NVDA‑US) Vera Rubin architecture, further strengthening its AI hardware portfolio.

However, Goldman Sachs cautions that weakening PC demand, slower enterprise IT spending, competitive pricing pressure, rising component costs and white‑label server vendors gaining market share could pressure Dell’s growth and margins.
Hewlett Packard Enterprise: Network Gear Becomes Another Growth Engine
Goldman Sachs also maintains a “Buy” rating on Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE‑US) but cuts its 12‑month target price from $79 to $75.

Goldman Sachs projects that HPE’s fiscal 2026 third‑quarter revenue will reach $12 billion, above market consensus, with cloud and AI revenues expected to grow 22% annually and networking revenues potentially surging 77%. Adjusted EPS is estimated at $0.94, slightly above the top of the company’s guidance range.

With hyperscale cloud providers expanding AI infrastructure and general‑purpose compute demand rebounding, Goldman Sachs raises its average EPS forecast for HPE for fiscal 2026‑2028 by 2%, reflecting an improved outlook for networking equipment revenue.

HPE recently won a deal with cloud provider Vultr to participate in large‑scale AI data‑center deployments, integrated Juniper Networks networking products into its AI data‑center solutions, and expanded collaborations with eight firms in the quantum‑computing space.
Potential risks include a slowdown in enterprise IT spending, competition from white‑label equipment, market‑share loss during Juniper integration, and rising component costs.
NetApp: Enterprise Storage Prices Support Growth

Goldman Sachs keeps a “Buy” rating on data‑storage company NetApp (NTAP‑US) and raises its 12‑month target price from $200 to $210, mainly due to confidence in enterprise infrastructure spending and rising average selling prices for storage gear.

Goldman Sachs estimates NetApp’s fiscal 2027 first‑quarter revenue at $1.81 billion, with EPS of $2.12, slightly above the company’s midpoint guidance. Based on higher average storage‑equipment prices, it lifts its revenue and EPS forecasts for fiscal 2027‑2029 by an average of 5% and 4% respectively.

NetApp’s last quarter revenue and profit both beat market expectations, prompting firms such as Argus and Barclays to raise their target prices. The company also announced the acquisition of AI data‑infrastructure provider DataPelago to expand its AI data‑management capabilities.

Goldman Sachs warns that NetApp could still face supply shortages, a long‑term decline in on‑premises storage demand, intensifying industry competition, and a weakening global macro‑economic environment.

items.title: 英特爾要殺回記憶體！陳立武挖SK海力士前高管 專家：暗示CPU+記憶體堆疊路線
items.title_en: Intel Aims to Revive Memory Business! CEO Pat Gelsinger Hires Former SK Hynix Exec, Experts Say It Hints at CPU+Memory Stacking Roadmap
paras: 英特爾執行長陳立武近期在一場公開對話中表示，該公司正著手研究「新型記憶體架構」，且已經從SK海力士挖角曾任該公司高管的Shil Lee加盟，加碼記憶體技術佈局。他並笑稱，外界「應該能猜到方向」，但細節暫不公開。
在一場播客節目上談到伺服器與資料中心業務時，陳立武坦承「這些年犯了不少錯誤」，但強調英特爾已重新引進頂尖CPU、GPU及系統架構師，同時擴充軟體團隊，目標是在下一輪算力週期中重奪主導地位。
記憶體被陳立武列為最關注的項目。陳立武指出，過去記憶體創新不足、淪為大宗商品，如今新技術湧現，已從大宗料件升級為戰略賽道，尤其是CPU與記憶體之間的堆疊技術，能提供多種整合路徑，成為架構突破關鍵。
他形容科技投資人「每天都能學到新東西」，暗示英特爾的記憶體路線恐跳出傳統DRAM/NVM框架，朝向近記憶體運算或3D堆疊整合推進。
在HBM與AI記憶體被SK海力士、三星主導的當下，英特爾借一位SK海力士前高管重啟架構級探索，信號意義大於產品本身。這家整合元件製造商(IDM)正試圖把「算力+記憶體協同設計」重新拿回自己手裡。
paras_en: Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger recently said in a public dialogue that the company is working on a “new memory architecture” and has hired former SK Hynix executive Shil Lee, who previously held a senior role at the Korean chipmaker, to bolster its memory technology efforts. He joked that outsiders “should be able to guess the direction,” but the details are not being disclosed yet.

Speaking on a podcast about the server and data‑center business, Gelsinger admitted that “we’ve made a lot of mistakes over the years,” but stressed that Intel has re‑hired top‑tier CPU, GPU and system architects and is expanding its software teams, aiming to retake the lead in the next compute‑power cycle.

Memory is listed by Gelsinger as his top priority. He noted that memory innovation has lagged in the past, turning it into a commodity, but new technologies are now emerging, elevating memory from a bulk material to a strategic arena—especially the stacking technology between CPUs and memory, which can provide multiple integration pathways and become a key architectural breakthrough.

He described tech investors as “learning something new every day,” hinting that Intel’s memory strategy may break out of the traditional DRAM/NVM framework and move toward near‑memory computing or 3D‑stacked integration.

At a time when HBM and AI‑focused memory are dominated by SK Hynix and Samsung, Intel’s recruitment of a former SK Hynix executive to restart architecture‑level exploration signals a move that matters more than any single product. The integrated device manufacturer is trying to bring “compute‑plus‑memory co‑design” back under its own control.

items.title: 記憶體成本壓力大！谷歌Pixel 11新機漲100美元 容量256GB起步 主打「Gemini Intelligence」
items.title_en: Memory Cost Pressure High! Google Pixel 11 New Machine Rises $100, Starting at $256GB, Mainly Promoting "Gemini Intelligence"
paras: 谷歌周三(12日)在「Made by Google」發表會推出Pixel 11、Pixel 11 Pro、Pixel 11 Pro XL與Pixel 11 Pro Fold四款新機，下周四(20日)正式開賣，分別要價899、1099、1299、1899美元，較上代Pixel 10全系列調漲100美元，漲價主因AI資料中心擠佔DRAM/NAND產能、RAM與快閃記憶體成本飆漲，谷歌設備主管Rick Osterloh更直言，RAM和快閃記憶體短缺正推高整個消費電子業成本。

因此，谷歌用「調結構」弱化漲價痛感：Pixel 11與Pixel 11 Pro砍掉128GB版、改從256GB起跳，兩款機型256GB版本本身未漲，但Pixel 11 Pro XL同容量(12GB/256GB)漲價100美元，且Pro/Pro XL基礎RAM從16GB降至12GB，用戶要回到16GB必須加買512GB或1TB版本。標準版Pixel 11搭載12GB+256GB起、6.3吋螢幕、Tensor G6+Titan M3，端側AI任務最高提速3.5倍。
Pixel 11系列新機主打「Gemini Intelligence」跨40多款App處理多步驟任務，相機新增Magic Capture，Pro系列附6個月Google AI Pro試用、加入HiLight RGB提示燈與Rambler聽寫工具。
事實上，早在6月25日，另一家美國智慧手機大廠蘋果已因「AI資料中心擴張引發記憶體空前短缺」上調MacBook Air(200美元)、MacBook Pro(300美元)、iPad Pro(200美元)等售價。
根據TrendForce數據，今年Q1智慧手機用DRAM合約價格季增88%–93%、NAND漲33%–38%，第二季DRAM再漲58%–63%，DDR5 16GB現貨年內漲幅破6倍，記憶體佔手機物料清單(BPM)比重從10%–15%飆至30%–40%。
Osterloh把AI稱為Pixel對抗iPhone的差異點，甚至預言「AI有一天會成為人們使用手機的主要方式」，但Counterpoint調查數據顯示，AI目前僅排在消費者換機理由第6、7位，仍輸給螢幕、電池、相機。
下周四開賣後，要價899美元起的Pixel 11賣得好不好，將直接回覆「Gemini值不值100美元溢價」這道題目。
paras_en: Google announced the Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, Pixel 11 Pro XL, and Pixel 11 Pro Fold at the "Made by Google" event on Wednesday (12th), which will go on sale next Thursday (20th) at $899, $1,099, $1,299, and $1,899 respectively, a $100 increase from the previous generation Pixel 10 series. The main reason for the price increase is the occupation of DRAM/NAND production capacity by AI data centers, as well as the sharp rise in RAM and flash memory costs. Google's hardware director Rick Osterloh even said that the shortage of RAM and flash memory is pushing up the cost of the entire consumer electronics industry.

Therefore, Google used "structural adjustments" to weaken the pain of price increases: Pixel 11 and Pixel 11 Pro dropped the 128GB version and started from 256GB, and the 256GB version of the two machines did not increase in price, but the Pixel 11 Pro XL with the same capacity (12GB/256GB) increased by $100, and the Pro/Pro XL base RAM was reduced from 16GB to 12GB. Users need to buy 512GB or 1TB versions to return to 16GB. The standard Pixel 11 is equipped with 12GB+256GB, 6.3-inch screen, Tensor G6+Titan M3, and the side AI task is accelerated by up to 3.5 times.

The Pixel 11 series new machines mainly promote "Gemini Intelligence" to handle multi-step tasks across 40+ apps, and the camera adds Magic Capture. The Pro series comes with 6 months of Google AI Pro trial, HiLight RGB indicator light, and Rambler handwriting tool.

In fact, as early as June 25th, another US smartphone giant Apple had increased the prices of MacBook Air ($200), MacBook Pro ($300), and iPad Pro ($200) due to "AI data center expansion causing unprecedented memory shortage".

According to TrendForce data, the DRAM contract price for smartphones in Q1 increased by 88%-93% and NAND increased by 33%-38%. In the second quarter, DRAM increased by 58%-63%, and DDR5 16GB increased by over 6 times in a year. The memory share of the smartphone bill of materials (BPM) increased from 10%-15% to 30%-40%.

Osterloh called AI the difference point of Pixel against iPhone, even predicting that "AI will one day become the main way people use their phones". However, Counterpoint's survey data shows that AI is currently ranked 6th and 7th in consumer replacement reasons, still losing to screen, battery, and camera.
After going on sale next Thursday, whether the Pixel 11 priced at $899 will sell well will directly answer the question of "whether Gemini is worth $100 more".

items.title: AI財報亮眼 晶片股逼近牛市！分析師提醒別高興太早？
items.title_en: Chip Stocks on Brink of Bull Market as AI Spending Remains Strong
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，晶片股在企業近期亮眼財報帶動下，再度逼近牛市門檻，但部分分析師提醒，這些財報未必足以支撐市場全面樂觀。
半導體類股周三(12日)表現強勁，SanDisk(SNDK-US)與美光科技(Micron Technology)(MU-US)分別上漲約6%及5%。另一家主要受惠於記憶體晶片需求的SK海力士(SK Hynix)(SKHY-US)，其ADR股價也大漲9%。
AI晶片製造商輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)及超微(Advanced Micro Devices, AMD)(AMD-US)分別上漲3%及2%。
費城半導體指數正逐步踏入牛市，周三收在12,399.38點。根據道瓊斯市場數據，費半必須升至12,536.99點，才能進入新的牛市。一般而言，牛市是指指數自近期低點上漲至少20%。
這波漲勢是在周二盤後CoreWeave(CRWV-US)、美超微電腦(Super Micro Computer)(SMCI-US)及Lumentum(LITE-US)公布財報後出現，這些財報顯示AI支出依然強勁。
投資顧問公司Portfolio Thinking創辦人Dan Kemp表示，這些企業位於AI產業鏈較下游位置，負責連接及安裝晶片以供使用，因此它們的財報讓投資人更直接看到晶片需求的實際情況，進一步支撐市場對半導體產業的樂觀情緒。
Kemp指出，「值得注意的是，支撐這些需求的承諾規模。」他以新興雲端服務商CoreWeave為例。該公司將全年資本支出計畫從原先的310億至350億美元，上調至350億至390億美元，但營收展望「相對溫和得多」。
Kemp指出，CoreWeave還公布第二季淨利息支出6.4億美元，而調整後營業利益僅1.28億美元。「我們還沒有看到足以合理化如此大規模支出承諾的消費者及企業支出。」
CoreWeave與美超微都強調積壓訂單持續增加，後者也重申，截至6月一季的新訂單金額已超過600億美元。
但考量部分訂單最終可能遭到取消或延後，Kemp表示自己仍對這些數字持懷疑態度。
他表示，「投資人有理由將龐大的積壓訂單視為正面訊號，但應該把它視為一系列可能的結果，而不是已經實現的營收。」
他認為，周三晶片股的漲勢也可能與當天稍早公布、整體符合華爾街預期的消費者物價指數(CPI)報告有關。
CoreWeave與美超微股價周三均大漲19%，為資料中心提供光學元件的Lumentum Holdings也上漲超過13%。
不過，Zacks Investment Management首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry表示，這些財報「有助於確認AI交易正在擴大，不只是變得更大」。
他表示，CoreWeave證實GPU需求依然強勁，Lumentum則展現出這項需求如何進一步帶動支撐及運行這些晶片所需的基礎建設。
然而，Mulberry認為，並非所有晶片公司都會以相同程度受惠，因此「基本面最終將更加重要」。他表示，投資人目前尋找的是加速成長，「而不只是單純的股價動能」。
在他看來，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)、博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)及光纖網路設備供應商Coherent(COHR-US)擁有最強勁基本面。
Kemp也持類似看法，他認為，對長期投資人而言，關鍵問題在於需求成長速度是否快過股價目前反映的程度。「在這一點上，目前的證據遠沒有那麼令人放心。」
paras_en: Chip stocks are nearing a bull market threshold after a string of strong earnings reports, but some analysts caution that these results may not be enough to sustain a broadly optimistic market.

Semiconductor stocks rallied on Wednesday, with SanDisk (SNDK-US) and Micron Technology (MU-US) rising around 6% and 5%, respectively. SK Hynix (SKHY-US), which benefits from memory chip demand, saw its ADR stock price surge 9%.
Nvidia (NVDA-US) and Advanced Micro Devices (AMD-US) rose 3% and 2%, respectively.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index is gradually approaching the bull market threshold, closing at 12,399.38 on Wednesday. According to data from the Dow Jones Market Data, the index must rise to 12,536.99 to enter a new bull market. Generally, a bull market is defined as a 20% increase from recent lows.
The recent rally is attributed to earnings reports from CoreWeave (CRWV-US), Super Micro Computer (SMCI-US), and Lumentum (LITE-US) on Tuesday, which showed strong AI spending.

Dan Kemp, founder of Portfolio Thinking, notes that these companies are located in the lower end of the AI industry chain, responsible for connecting and installing chips for use. Their earnings reports provide a more direct view of chip demand, further supporting the market's optimistic sentiment towards the semiconductor industry.

Kemp points out that "what's worth noting is the commitment scale supporting these demands." He uses CoreWeave as an example, which increased its full-year capital expenditure plan from $31 billion to $39 billion, but its revenue outlook is "relatively mild."

Kemp notes that CoreWeave also reported second-quarter net interest expense of $64 million, with adjusted operating income of $128 million. "We haven't seen enough evidence to justify such a large-scale commitment of spending," he says.
CoreWeave and Super Micro both emphasized that backlog orders continue to increase, with the latter reiterating that new orders exceeding $6 billion as of June quarter.
However, considering that some orders may ultimately be canceled or delayed, Kemp remains skeptical about these numbers.
He notes that "investors have reason to view massive backlog orders as a positive signal, but they should view it as a series of possible outcomes rather than realized revenue."
He believes that Wednesday's chip stock rally may also be related to the earlier-than-expected release of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, which met Wall Street expectations.
CoreWeave and Super Micro stock prices both surged 19% on Wednesday, with Lumentum Holdings rising over 13%.
However, Zacks Investment Management Chief Market Strategist Brian Mulberry notes that these earnings reports "help confirm that AI trading is expanding, not just getting bigger."
He notes that CoreWeave's earnings confirmed strong GPU demand, while Lumentum showed how this demand drives further investment in the infrastructure needed to support and run these chips.

However, Mulberry believes that not all chip companies will benefit equally, and "the fundamental picture will ultimately become more important." He notes that investors are currently seeking accelerated growth, "not just simple stock price momentum."
In his view, Nvidia (NVDA-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US), and Coherent (COHR-US) have the strongest fundamentals.

Kemp also shares this view, noting that the key issue for long-term investors is whether demand growth is outpacing the current stock price reflection. "At this point, the evidence is far from reassuring."

items.title: 馬斯克Grok 4.6亮相！性能追平GPT-5.6 Sol、API價格砍半
items.title_en: Musk's Grok 4.6 Debuts with Performance Matching GPT-5.6 Sol, API Price Cut in Half
paras: 馬斯克旗下SpaceXAI(原xAI)周三(12日)正式推出新一代旗艦模型Grok 4.6, 將主要升級方向鎖定長時間運行的AI代理(Agent)、複雜程式設計、知識工作及互動與視覺任務。SpaceXAI表示, Grok 4.6在多項前沿模型測試中已進入第一梯隊, 同時以每100萬個輸入Token 2美元、輸出Token 6美元的價格切入市場, 約為部分競爭對手的一半, 企圖以「高性能+低成本」策略搶攻開發者市場。
SpaceXAI在官方公告中表示, Grok 4.6是在Grok 4.5基礎上進一步強化, 特別針對長時間運行的Agent及更具挑戰性的互動、視覺工作。新模型可以處理需要多步驟執行的研究工作、程式碼庫分析及應用程式開發, 並在更長的任務過程中進行自主測試與驗證, 讓模型不只是回答問題, 而是能持續完成一項完整工作。
SpaceXAI指出, Grok 4.6接受比Grok 4.5更長的補充訓練, 訓練資料包括經過篩選的模型生成推理資料及高品質工程資料, 同時改進最佳化器與訓練方法。公司並利用Grok 4.5生成不同推理強度、Agent框架以及STEM、軟體工程和知識工作等領域的SFT軌跡, 再透過強化學習訓練Grok 4.6執行通用程式設計、知識工作、核心程式最佳化、網頁開發及電腦輔助設計等任務。
這次升級最受市場關注的之一, 是Grok 4.6在Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index取得61分, 與OpenAI的GPT-5.6 Sol並列。Artificial Analysis指出, 該指數綜合多項測試, 用來評估模型在數學、科學、程式設計與推理等不同能力的整體表現。Grok 4.6因此進一步縮小與頂級模型之間的性能差距。
在GDPVal-AA v2測試中, Grok 4.6則取得1,753 Elo, 高於GPT-5.6 Sol的1,728分及Anthropic旗下Claude Fable 5的1,741分。這項測試著重於具有實際經濟價值的專業工作, 包括不同職業與產業的知識工作任務, 更接近企業實際導入AI代理後可能面對的工作場景。

不過, Grok 4.6並非在所有評測中都取得第一。SpaceXAI公布的其他測試顯示, 新模型在CursorBench v3.2取得69.9%, 高於Grok 4.5 High的66.7%; FrontierCode v1.1達61.3%, 高於前代56.6%; APEX-Agents達57.5%, 高於前代47.1%; APEX-SWE為56.4%, 高於前代53.6%; AA-Briefcase則由前代1,313分提升至1,577分; Harvey LAB也由12.9%提高至15.8%。
在部分測試中, 競爭對手仍然領先, 因此較準確的說法是Grok 4.6已在多項Agent、程式設計及知識工作測試進入頂級模型行列, 而非全面擊敗所有競爭模型。Artificial Analysis的排名也會隨模型新增與測試更新而變動, 因此SpaceXAI公布的排名主要反映發布時點的橫向比較。
除了模型性能, Grok 4.6的價格策略更可能成為AI產業下一階段競爭的焦點。SpaceXAI將標準API價格設定為每100萬個輸入Token 2美元、每100萬個輸出Token 6美元, 並提供速度更快、價格約為兩倍的版本。公司宣稱, 標準版本價格約為其他前沿模型的一半。
這項定價策略將Grok 4.6直接推向開發者及企業AI市場。相較之下, 市場目前對前沿模型的競爭已逐漸從單純比拚基準測試, 延伸到每次推理成本、Token效率、速度以及能否完成實際工作的能力。當模型性能逐漸接近時, 相同工作究竟需要多少運算成本, 很可能成為企業選擇模型的重要因素。
不過, API單價並不代表所有任務的最終成本都會同比下降。不同模型的Token消耗、推理強度、任務執行時間以及Agent需要呼叫多少次工具, 都會影響實際使用成本。因此, Grok 4.6的「半價」主要是API標價上的比較, 並不意味著所有應用場景的總成本都一定低50%。
SpaceXAI也同步擴大Grok 4.6的開發者通路。新模型已提供給Cursor、Grok Build及API使用, 並透過OpenRouter、Vercel及Cloudflare(NET-US)等平台與服務商提供。SpaceXAI表示, 上線首周Cursor與Grok Build用戶可獲得2倍包含用量, 讓開發者能以更低門檻測試新模型。
這也延續SpaceXAI近幾個月積極搶攻AI程式開發市場的策略。公司7月推出Grok Build開源版本, 將旗下程式設計Agent的核心框架公開, 包括上下文組裝、工具調用、程式碼讀取與修改、命令執行、技能、插件及子Agent等功能, 並允許開發者在本地環境運行。
Grok Build原先已被SpaceXAI定位為面向專業軟體工程與複雜程式設計工作的Coding Agent, 使用者可以先讓模型規劃工作, 再審核與批准執行計畫, 每次程式碼修改也會以差異檔案方式呈現。Grok 4.6此次進一步強化Agent能力, 等於為這套開發工具提供更強大的模型引擎。
SpaceXAI此次還特別強調, Grok 4.6在「把想法變成產品」方面有明顯提升。面對一個模糊的產品概念, 模型可以先研究陌生領域, 設計應用架構, 建立核心功能, 再根據測試結果及使用者回饋進行多輪修改。在視覺及互動式專案中, 新模型也能更快產出完整的第一版成果。
這種能力反映AI模型競爭正從「問答」走向「執行」。過去大模型主要以回答問題、生成文字或程式碼作為能力展示, 現在OpenAI、Anthropic、Google及SpaceXAI等業者都逐步把Agent能力視為下一個競爭戰場, 希望模型能自行使用工具、拆解任務、修改成果並完成長時間工作。
Grok 4.6在GDPVal-AA v2的表現尤其符合這項趨勢。SpaceXAI公布的1,753 Elo不只是一般知識問答成績, 而是來自需要模型在Agent環境中完成實際專業工作的測試, 因此公司試圖藉此證明新模型不只是「聊天能力」提升, 而是已能處理更接近企業工作流程的任務。
馬斯克也迅速在社群平台X為新模型造勢。他轉發Grok 4.6取得1,753 Elo及在多項測試領先的相關內容, 並對新模型作出高度評價。這也是馬斯克近期持續親自推廣Grok產品的最新例子。
從產業競爭角度來看, Grok 4.6的推出時間也值得注意。Grok 4.5才在7月16日發布, SpaceXAI不到一個月便推出下一代版本。Grok 4.5當時已將程式設計、Agent任務及知識工作列為主要能力, 並強調與Cursor共同訓練, 顯示SpaceXAI正在快速縮短模型迭代週期。
SpaceXAI近期也持續把Grok從聊天機器人擴展為完整AI工作平台。7月推出的Automations功能允許使用者設定一次工作, 之後讓Grok按照排程或收到電子郵件等觸發條件自行執行, 並回報結果; 5月推出的Connectors則讓Grok直接連接企業及個人使用的應用程式, 執行讀取電子郵件、整理文件、更新簡報、管理行事曆及編輯試算表等工作。
因此, Grok 4.6的真正戰略意義可能不只是與GPT或Claude比拚排行榜, 而是SpaceXAI正試圖建立從模型、Agent、Coding工具到第三方開發平台的完整生態系。若低API價格能夠吸引大量開發者, 再透過Cursor、Grok Build、OpenRouter及雲端平台擴大使用, SpaceXAI便有機會在模型之外取得更大的開發者入口。
不過, 低價策略也代表SpaceXAI必須承擔更高的運算成本壓力。前沿模型的訓練與推理都需要大量GPU及資料中心資源, 若模型價格持續下探, AI業者必須依靠更高的使用量、更高的Token效率或其他商業模式來支撐毛利率。這也意味著Grok 4.6的價格戰不只是爭取市占率, 同時也是對SpaceXAI基礎設施效率的一項考驗。
對開發者而言, Grok 4.6的吸引力則在於它同時提供前沿級性能與相對低廉的API價格。若其在實際工作中的Token效率及任務完成率能夠維持目前的測試表現, 開發者可能更願意把Grok納入程式設計、研究、資料分析及企業Agent工作流。
而對OpenAI與Anthropic等競爭對手而言, Grok 4.6也進一步加劇前沿模型價格壓力。當新模型在部分專業工作測試中已能取得領先, 同時API價格又明顯較低, 市場競爭就不再只是誰的模型最聰明, 而是誰能以最低成本完成最多工作。
目前Grok 4.6已經可以透過API以及部分開發者平台使用, 但不同平台的可用方式與方案可能有所差異。SpaceXAI此次發布的重點也主要放在開發者與Agent應用, 而非單純消費者聊天產品的更新。

整體而言, Grok 4.6顯示SpaceXAI正在把AI競賽的戰場從單一模型性能, 推向長時間Agent執行能力、程式設計、知識工作及推理成本。61分的Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index與1,753 Elo的GDPVal-AA v2成績, 讓Grok進一步站上前沿模型競爭舞台; 每100萬Token輸入2美元、輸出6美元的價格, 則是SpaceXAI試圖擴大市場滲透率的另一張王牌。
隨著模型能力差距逐漸縮小, AI產業下一階段的勝負關鍵可能從「誰擁有最高分」轉向「誰能以更低成本完成更多工作」。Grok 4.6此次同時押注性能與價格, 能否真正轉化為開發者使用量與企業採用, 將決定這場AI模型價格戰究竟只是一次產品攻勢, 還是成為SpaceXAI搶進前沿AI市場的重要轉折點。
paras_en: Elon Musk's SpaceXAI (formerly xAI) officially launched its new flagship model, Grok 4.6, on Wednesday, focusing on long-running AI agents, complex programming, knowledge work, and interactive and visual tasks. SpaceXAI stated that Grok 4.6 has entered the top tier in multiple cutting-edge model tests, with a market entry price of $2 per 1 million input tokens and $6 per 1 million output tokens, approximately half of some competitors' prices, aiming to capture the developer market with a 'high-performance + low-cost' strategy.

SpaceXAI announced that Grok 4.6 is an enhancement of Grok 4.5, particularly for long-running agents and more challenging interactive and visual tasks. The new model can handle research tasks, codebase analysis, and application development that require multiple steps, and can perform autonomous testing and validation over longer task processes, enabling the model to not only answer questions but also complete a whole task.

SpaceXAI pointed out that Grok 4.6 has undergone longer supplemental training than Grok 4.5, with training data including filtered model-generated reasoning data and high-quality engineering data, and has improved optimizers and training methods. The company used Grok 4.5 to generate different reasoning strengths, agent frameworks, and SFT trajectories in STEM, software engineering, and knowledge work, and then trained Grok 4.6 using reinforcement learning to perform general programming, knowledge work, core program optimization, web development, and computer-aided design tasks.

One of the most closely watched upgrades is Grok 4.6's score of 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, tied with OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol. Artificial Analysis stated that the index combines multiple tests to evaluate a model's overall performance in mathematics, science, programming, and reasoning. Grok 4.6 has thus further narrowed the performance gap with top models.

In the GDPVal-AA v2 test, Grok 4.6 scored 1,753 Elo, higher than GPT-5.6 Sol's 1,728 and Anthropic's Claude Fable 5's 1,741. This test focuses on professional tasks with practical economic value, including knowledge work tasks in various professions and industries, which is closer to the work scenarios that enterprises may face when introducing AI agents.

However, Grok 4.6 did not rank first in all evaluations. Other tests released by SpaceXAI show that the new model scored 69.9% on CursorBench v3.2, higher than Grok 4.5 High's 66.7%; 61.3% on FrontierCode v1.1, higher than the previous generation's 56.6%; 57.5% on APEX-Agents, higher than the previous generation's 47.1%; 56.4% on APEX-SWE, higher than the previous generation's 53.6%; and 1,577 on AA-Briefcase, up from the previous generation's 1,313. Harvey LAB also increased from 12.9% to 15.8%.

In some tests, competitors still lead, so it is more accurate to say that Grok 4.6 has entered the top tier in multiple agent, programming, and knowledge work tests, rather than comprehensively defeating all competing models. Artificial Analysis's rankings will also change with the addition of new models and updates, so SpaceXAI's released rankings mainly reflect the horizontal comparison at the time of release.

In addition to model performance, Grok 4.6's pricing strategy is likely to become the focus of competition in the AI industry. SpaceXAI set the standard API price at $2 per 1 million input tokens and $6 per 1 million output tokens, and offers a faster, more expensive version. The company claims that the standard version is approximately half the price of other cutting-edge models.

This pricing strategy directly targets the developer and enterprise AI markets. In contrast, the current competition for cutting-edge models has gradually shifted from simply comparing benchmark tests to the cost of each inference, token efficiency, speed, and the ability to complete actual work. As model performance approaches each other, the operating cost required for the same work may become an important factor for enterprises to choose models.

However, the API unit price does not mean that the final cost of all tasks will decrease by the same proportion. The token consumption, reasoning strength, task execution time, and the number of times an agent needs to call tools will affect the actual usage cost. Therefore, Grok 4.6's 'half-price' is mainly a comparison of API pricing and does not mean that the total cost of all application scenarios will definitely be 50% lower.

SpaceXAI is also expanding Grok 4.6's developer channels. The new model is already available for use through Cursor, Grok Build, and API, and is provided to platform and service providers such as OpenRouter, Vercel, and Cloudflare (NET-US). SpaceXAI stated that users of Cursor and Grok Build can receive double the included usage in the first week, allowing developers to test the new model at a lower threshold.

This continues SpaceXAI's strategy of aggressively capturing the AI programming market in recent months. In July, the company released the open-source version of Grok Build, making the core framework of its programming design agent public, including context assembly, tool invocation, code reading and modification, command execution, skills, plugins, and sub-agents, and allowing developers to run it in a local environment.

Grok Build was originally positioned by SpaceXAI as a coding agent for professional software engineering and complex programming tasks. Users can let the model plan the work, review and approve the plan, and modify the code, with each modification presented as a diff file. Grok 4.6 further strengthens the agent's capabilities, providing a more powerful model engine for this development tool.

SpaceXAI also emphasized that Grok 4.6 has significantly improved its ability to 'turn ideas into products'. When faced with a vague product concept, the model can research unfamiliar fields, design application architectures, establish core functions, and modify them based on test results and user feedback. In visual and interactive projects, the new model can also produce a complete first draft faster.

This ability reflects the shift in AI model competition from 'Q&A' to 'execution'. In the past, large models mainly demonstrated their capabilities by answering questions, generating text, or code. Now, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and SpaceXAI are gradually regarding agent capabilities as the next competitive battlefield, hoping that models can use tools, break down tasks, modify results, and complete long-term work on their own.

Grok 4.6's performance in GDPVal-AA v2 is particularly in line with this trend. SpaceXAI's released 1,753 Elo is not only a general knowledge Q&A score but also comes from tests that require the model to complete actual professional tasks in an agent environment. The company is trying to prove that the new model is not only improved in 'chatting ability' but also capable of handling tasks closer to enterprise workflows.

Musk also quickly promoted the new model on the social platform X. He forwarded related content about Grok 4.6's 1,753 Elo and its lead in multiple tests, and gave high praise to the new model. This is also the latest example of Musk personally promoting Grok products in recent times.

From an industry competition perspective, the timing of Grok 4.6's release is also noteworthy. Grok 4.5 was released on July 16, and SpaceXAI released the next-generation version in less than a month. Grok 4.5 had already positioned programming, agent tasks, and knowledge work as its main capabilities and emphasized its joint training with Cursor, showing that SpaceXAI is shortening the model iteration cycle.

SpaceXAI has also been continuously expanding Grok from a chatbot to a complete AI work platform. The Automations feature released in July allows users to set up a task and let Grok execute it according to a schedule or trigger conditions and report the results. The Connectors released in May allow Grok to directly connect to enterprise and personal applications, performing tasks such as reading emails, organizing files, updating presentations, managing calendars, and editing spreadsheets.

Therefore, the true strategic significance of Grok 4.6 may not only be competing with GPT or Claude in rankings but also SpaceXAI's attempt to establish a complete ecosystem from models, agents, coding tools to third-party development platforms. If the low API price can attract a large number of developers and expand usage through Cursor, Grok Build, OpenRouter, and cloud platforms, SpaceXAI may have the opportunity to gain a larger developer entry point beyond models.

However, the low-price strategy also means that SpaceXAI must bear higher computational cost pressure. The training and inference of cutting-edge models require a large amount of GPU and data center resources. If model prices continue to decline, AI companies must rely on higher usage, higher token efficiency, or other business models to support profit margins. This also means that Grok 4.6's price war is not only a competition for market share but also a test of SpaceXAI's infrastructure efficiency.

For developers, Grok 4.6's appeal lies in its simultaneous provision of cutting-edge performance and relatively low API prices. If its token efficiency and task completion rate in actual work can maintain the current test performance, developers may be more willing to incorporate Grok into programming, research, data analysis, and enterprise agent workflows.

For competitors like OpenAI and Anthropic, Grok 4.6 further increases the price pressure on cutting-edge models. When a new model has already taken the lead in some professional work tests and its API price is significantly lower, market competition is no longer just about whose model is the smartest, but also about who can complete the most work at the lowest cost.

Currently, Grok 4.6 is available for use through API and some developer platforms, but the availability and plans on different platforms may vary. SpaceXAI's focus in this release is mainly on developer and agent applications, rather than updates to single consumer chat products.

Overall, Grok 4.6 shows that SpaceXAI is shifting the AI competition battlefield from single-model performance to long-term agent execution capabilities, programming, knowledge work, and reasoning costs. The 61-score on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and the 1,753 Elo on GDPVal-AA v2 have allowed Grok to further stand on the cutting-edge model competition stage; the price of $2 per 1 million input tokens and $6 per 1 million output tokens is another trump card for SpaceXAI to expand its market penetration.

As the model capability gap narrows, the key to winning in the AI industry may shift from 'who has the highest score' to 'who can complete more work at a lower cost'. Grok 4.6's bet on both performance and price may be able to translate into developer usage and enterprise adoption, which will determine whether this AI model price war is just a product offensive or a significant turning point for SpaceXAI to advance into the cutting-edge AI market.

items.title: 美國干預日元反而更危險？《財富》警告市場恐被「大玩家」綁架
items.title_en: Is U.S. Intervention in the Yen More Dangerous? Fortune Warns the Market May Be Hijacked by a “Big Player”
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）與日本財務省聯手干預外匯市場，試圖推動日元升至他眼中「更合理」的水準。然而，這場看似為穩定匯市而來的行動，可能反而釋放出更危險的訊號：當市場開始揣摩政策官員的一言一行，而非依循經濟基本面定價，匯市波動恐怕不減反增。
貝森特先前接受福斯財經網（Fox Business）訪問時直言，日元遭到「嚴重低估」，並認為貨幣「過度波動」並不健康，等同公開質疑市場形成的日元價格。隨著貝森特與日本財務省採取行動，日元隨即走強，但這波升勢究竟能否持續，仍有待觀察。
「大玩家」進場 市場定價邏輯生變
日元走強有兩項主要原因。首先是相關機構直接買進日元；其次，也是影響更大的因素，是貝森特與日本財務大臣片山皋月透過公開發言向市場施壓。兩人均明確表態希望日元升值，並準備透過干預措施支撐疲弱的日元。
《財富》分析指出，這種足以透過言論與行動改變市場走勢的政策人物，是市場中的「大玩家」。「大玩家」最大的特徵，在於其決策不必遵循簡單、明確的規則，而是高度依賴個人判斷。當市場無法預測其下一步行動，政策干預本身就可能成為新的不確定性來源。

The yen’s strength stems from two main drivers. First, the relevant authorities are directly buying yen. When traders start chasing every move of the “big player,” the volatility that policy originally sought to suppress could be amplified further.

items.title: AI競賽告急！谷歌共同創辦人布林下場督戰 DeepMind大重組 加速衝刺Gemini
items.title_en: AI Competition in Crisis! Google Co-Founder Brin Steps Down to Cheer on DeepMind's Major Overhaul to Accelerate Gemini
paras: 外媒引述知情人士最新報導指出，谷歌母公司Alphabet正力圖縮小與競爭對手在AI的差距，因共同創辦人Sergey Brin近幾個月敦促公司重要AI團隊全力投入Gemini模型研發。
一位匿名知情人士透露，今年4月Anthropic憑藉強大的Claude Mythos模型預覽版取得領先之際，Brin在一場數百名員工參加的內部大會發表談話，要求DeepMind人工智慧實驗室加快開發進度。
去年11月，Gemini模型曾短暫超越競爭對手，但Anthropic與OpenAI隨後推出的新版本模型，再度讓谷歌處於追趕狀態。
兩位知情人士指出，到今年8月，由於內部測試顯示Gemini在程序編碼等領域表現仍落後競爭對手，谷歌將新一代旗艦版Gemini推遲兩個月推出。
上周三(5日)，谷歌宣布全面改組DeepMind人工智慧部門領導層，該部門負責人Demis Hassabis卸下主管職務，由其副手Koray Kavukcuoglu接任，Hassabis則轉任董事長，管理權責縮減。同時，Gemini最初的兩位技術聯合負責人辭職，共同創辦一家新創公司。
儘管一些產業觀察人士質疑谷歌是否正退出大型模型競賽，但根據外媒對7名了解Gemini開發情況人士的訪問顯示，Alphabet的商業化戰略及上周三的人事重組，都與爭奪模型主導地位的努力密切相關。
paras_en: According to a recent report by a source familiar with the matter, Alphabet, the parent company of Google, is making a concerted effort to narrow the gap with its competitors in the AI field, as co-founder Sergey Brin has been urging the company's key AI teams to focus on developing the Gemini model over the past few months.

A source close to the matter revealed that in April, Anthropic took the lead with its powerful Claude Mythos model preview, prompting Brin to deliver a speech at an internal conference attended by hundreds of employees, urging DeepMind's artificial intelligence laboratory to accelerate its development pace.
Last November, the Gemini model briefly surpassed its competitors, but Anthropic and OpenAI's subsequent release of new versions of their models put Google back in a catch-up position.

Two sources pointed out that by August, due to internal testing showing that Gemini still lagged behind its competitors in areas such as programming, Google delayed the release of its next-generation flagship Gemini model by two months.

Last Wednesday (5th), Google announced a comprehensive overhaul of the leadership team at DeepMind's artificial intelligence department, with Demis Hassabis stepping down as head of the department and being replaced by his deputy Koray Kavukcuoglu, while Hassabis took on the role of chairman and saw his responsibilities reduced. At the same time, the two original technical co-leaders of Gemini resigned and co-founded a new startup.

Despite some industry observers questioning whether Google is withdrawing from the competition for large-scale models, according to media reports based on interviews with seven people familiar with the Gemini development process, Alphabet's commercial strategy and last Wednesday's personnel reshuffle are closely related to the efforts to dominate the model market.

items.title: 白銀多頭列車要加速！花旗喊上看90美元 潛在漲幅近4成
items.title_en: Silver Bull Train Must Accelerate! Citi Forecasts Up to $90, Potential Gain Near 40%
paras: 花旗最新重申對白銀的看多立場，預估隨著投資買盤接棒成為主要推力，銀價未來 3 個月可望升至每盎司 75 美元，未來 6 至 12 個月更可能挑戰 90 美元，較目前約 65 美元的現貨價格上漲約 38%。
花旗認為，白銀接下來的漲勢將不再主要仰賴工業用途，而是由資金流向主導。隨著荷姆茲海峽緊張局勢最終可望降溫，加上聯準會政策立場可能轉趨溫和，先前壓抑貴金屬的美元走強與實質利率上升等因素有望逐步消退，帶動白銀投資需求持續回升。
由於白銀通常與黃金同向波動，但價格彈性更高。
花旗形容，若荷姆茲海峽僵局迅速化解，白銀將成為押注貴金屬上漲的理想標的。該行基本情境預估，中東局勢最快可能在今年 9 月至 12 月間緩和，屆時白銀有望以更大幅度跟進金價上漲。
另一方面，白銀的工業需求前景開始出現結構性變化。太陽能業者持續減少單位電池的白銀用量，並加快採用背接觸式 (BC) 電池技術，可能使太陽能產業對白銀的需求成長放緩。花旗預估，BC 技術最快可於 2028 年成為太陽能市場的主流技術之一。
不過，人工智慧 (AI)、5G及電動車產業對白銀的需求仍具韌性，花旗預期全球白銀市場至少到 2027 年都將維持供不應求，為銀價提供中長期支撐。
印度市場也是另一項利多。目前印度國內銀價較國際價格溢價約 7%，反映當地買盤強勁。隨著第四季節慶及婚禮旺季到來，印度白銀需求可望進一步升溫。
paras_en: Citi reiterated its bullish stance on silver, estimating that with investment buying taking over as the main driver, the price could rise to $75 per ounce within the next three months and potentially challenge $90 within six to twelve months – about a 38% increase from the current spot price of roughly $65.

Citi believes the upcoming rally in silver will be driven less by industrial use and more by capital flows. As tensions in the Hormuz Strait are expected to ease and the Fed’s policy stance may become more dovish, the previously suppressive factors for precious metals—such as a strong dollar and rising real rates—should gradually recede, reviving investment demand for silver.
Silver typically moves in tandem with gold, but its price is more elastic.

Citi described that if the Hormuz Strait deadlock is resolved quickly, silver would become an ideal vehicle for betting on a rise in precious metals. The bank’s baseline scenario projects that the Middle‑East situation could ease as early as September to December this year, at which point silver is likely to follow gold’s gains with an even larger jump.

On the other hand, the outlook for silver’s industrial demand is beginning to shift structurally. Solar manufacturers are continuously reducing the amount of silver per cell and accelerating the adoption of back‑contact (BC) cell technology, which could slow the growth of silver demand from the solar sector. Citi estimates that BC technology could become one of the mainstream solar technologies as early as 2028.

Nevertheless, demand for silver from AI, 5G and electric‑vehicle industries remains resilient. Citi expects the global silver market to stay in deficit at least through 2027, providing medium‑ to long‑term support for prices.

India also offers a tailwind. Domestic silver prices in India carry a premium of about 7% over international levels, reflecting strong local buying. With the fourth‑quarter festive season and wedding rush approaching, Indian silver demand is expected to heat up further.

items.title: 月底生效！獲MSCI中國指數納入 智譜早盤在港股飆逾6%
items.title_en: Surge over 6%! Zhi Pian included in MSCI China Index, set to take effect on August 31
paras: 港股AI標的智谱今(13)日早盤漲逾6%至每股1297港元，因MSCI在昨日公布的成分股季度審議結果中，將包括智譜在內33檔標的納入MSCI中國指數，智谱與建滔集團為唯二新進港股，另含芯源微、風華高科、大族激光等31檔A股，同時剔除協鑫科技、金力永磁、智飛生物等32檔。上述調整將於8月31日收盤後生效。
由於MSCI中國指數被劃入MSCI新興市場指數與全球標準指數系列，入列即意味獲全球ETF與被動基金跟蹤，預計生效日尾盤將迎來海外資金集中買入。本次新興市場新增成分股市值前三為智谱、南亞科、鼎泰高科。
基本面上，大和證券日前首度給予智譜「買進」評等、目標價1500港元，認為智谱技術迭代正轉化為收入，上月年度雲端經常性收入(ARR)達10億美元，較原定目標提前五個月，集團營收有望由去年7.24億人民幣增至2029年的475億人民幣，年複合成長率185%，2029年毛利率回升至40%並轉虧為盈。
市場解讀，智谱獲納MSCI，加上MaaS商業化提速，讓港股AI基礎模型族群獲指數化配置錨點，但短期股價已反映部分預期，後續仍看token消耗、企業客戶留存與中國國產晶片適配進度。8月31日生效前，被動資金流向與北水態度將成短線觀察重點。
paras_en: Zhi Pian (HK: 1297) surged over 6% to HK$1,297 in early trading today, following MSCI's quarterly review results announced yesterday, which included Zhi Pian among 33 stocks to be added to the MSCI China Index. Zhi Pian and Build King Group are the only two new entrants from Hong Kong, while 31 A-shares, including Xingsource Micro, Windhwa High-tech, and Dahua Laser, were also included. Meanwhile, 32 stocks, including Cooperation Xin, Gold Force Permanent Magnet, and Zhifeng Bio, were removed. The adjustments will take effect after the close on August 31.

As MSCI China Index is included in the MSCI Emerging Markets Index and Global Standard Index series, being included means gaining global ETF and passive fund tracking. It is expected that overseas capital will flow in during the tail end of the trading day on the effective date. The top three stocks in terms of market value among the new additions to the emerging markets index are Zhi Pian, Nansheng Technology, and Ding Tai High-tech.

From a fundamental perspective, Daiwa Securities recently gave Zhi Pian a 'buy' rating, with a target price of HK$1,500. They believe that Zhi Pian's technology iteration is transforming into revenue. The company's annual cloud recurring revenue (ARR) reached US$1 billion in the previous month, five months ahead of the original target. The company's revenue is expected to increase from RMB 7.24 billion last year to RMB 47.5 billion in 2029, with a year-on-year compound growth rate of 185%. The gross margin is expected to rise to 40% in 2029 and turn from a loss to a profit.

Market interpretation is that Zhi Pian's inclusion in the MSCI index, combined with the acceleration of MaaS commercialization, has provided a benchmark for index allocation for the Hong Kong AI base model group. However, the stock price has already reflected part of the expectations, and the subsequent focus will be on token consumption, enterprise customer retention, and China's domestic chip adaptation progress. Before the effective date of August 31, the flow of passive funds and the attitude of northbound capital will be key short-term observations.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】美國CPI如預期，美元小幅上漲
paras: ◆USD/JPY

美國7月成屋銷售連續兩個月下跌，但小企業信心指數升至十一個月高點，並據美國和葉門親伊朗的胡塞武裝分別報告對航運的襲擊及北韓發射導彈的消息，週三令亞洲市場不安，並關注美國消費者價格指數(CPI)數據，尋找美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)可能升息的線索，支撐美元持穩，但8月路透短觀調查顯示，受惠於強勁半導體需求，日本製造業景氣判斷指數創3月以來最高達正18，同時因國內消費強勁，非製造業景氣判斷指數升至正28，並據東京短資數據，日本央行(BOJ)在9月加息的概率已升至78%，而且中東局勢再添不確定性，推升原油價格及加劇通貨膨脹擔憂，促使五年期日本公債收益率創歷史新高，對政策利率最敏感的兩年期日本公債收益率亦升至1995年5月以來最高，提供日圓支撐。

隨後美國公布7月消費者物價指數(CPI)分別較前月與上年同期漲0.1%及3.4%符合預期，但扣除食品和能源成分的核心CPI較去年同期降至2.5%，通貨膨脹連續兩個月降溫，促使芝加哥商品交易所(CME)的FedWatch工具顯示FED在9月15-16日會議升息的機率跌至38%，打擊美元兌日圓至158.67低點。隨著英國金融時報報導，美國波士頓聯邦儲備銀行柯林斯表示若通貨膨脹率居高不下，支持FED在9月加息，而且細項數據來看，美國通貨膨脹壓力有擴散跡象及FED青睞的個人消費支出(PCE)物價指標料仍維持3%，推升美元兌日圓至159.54高點。預估今日美元兌日圓支撐於158.80-159.00，阻力於159.70-90。
◆EUR/USD
澳洲央行(RBA)維持利率在4.35%不變，但總裁布洛克在新聞發布會上釋放更鷹派訊號表示，若通貨膨脹未能如預期般回落，完全有可能再升息，突顯10月底公布第三季CPI數據的重要性，而且市場預計FED於9月加息的概率約50%，相對RBA於11月再收緊貨幣政策的可能性大致相當，昨日支撐澳幣和紐元，帶動歐元兌美元觸及1.1562高點。
據德國聯邦統計局公布7月CPI與消費者物價調和指數(HICP)終值均較上年同期漲2.8%，與初值一致，但海灣地區船隻再次遭襲擊及美國與伊朗雙方立場趨於強硬，近期達成和平協議的希望似乎更加渺茫，推低歐元兌美元匯價至1.1519低點。預估今日歐元兌美元阻力於1.1530-50，支撐於1.1450-70。
◆GBP/USD

週三英國首相伯納姆接受英國廣播公司(BBC)電台採訪表示，儘管財政前景艱難，政府仍將盡力幫助企業降低成本，而且英國經濟尚未疲軟到足以平息英國央行(BOE)進一步加息的爭論，並因財政不確定性導致英國公債收益率期限溢價維持近二十年最高水平附近，提振英鎊兌美元至1.3541高點。隨著美國7月CPI符合預期，推遲FED可能加息的時間，但數據公布前市場大舉作多美元，而且中東局勢持續緊張及油價上漲支撐美元，打壓英鎊兌美元至1.3484低點。預估今日英鎊兌美元阻力於1.3500-20，支撐於1.3410-30。

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元抹去CPI數據後跌幅 荷姆茲海峽局勢不明推升避險需求
paras: 美元周三(12日)從盤中低點反彈並小幅走升，中東和平協議的不確定性，抵銷了符合預期的7月消費者通膨數據所帶來的影響。最新通膨數據降低了市場對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。
近期投資人提高對貨幣政策收緊的預期，帶動美元走強，但最新通膨數據並未出現足以延續這波漲勢的意外升幅。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.2%，報99.98。CPI數據早上公布後，美元指數一度擴大跌幅，觸及99.61盤中低點，之後回升並在中午前轉為走高。
外匯市場參與者周三將焦點集中在7月消費者物價指數(CPI)報告，以尋找更多貨幣政策前景的線索。上周五公布的7月就業報告弱於預期，導致市場迅速重新調整對聯準會9月升息的預期。
根據美國勞工統計局數據，7月整體CPI月增0.1%，6月則下跌0.4%。年增率則從6月的3.5%放緩至3.4%。扣除食品及能源價格的核心CPI，7月月增0.2%，6月則持平。年增率也從2.6%放緩至2.5%。上述4項數據均符合市場預期。
周四將接著公布7月生產者物價指數(PPI)。雖然CPI與PPI都是市場廣泛關注的通膨指標，但聯準會更偏好追蹤個人消費支出(PCE)物價指數，以評估通膨情勢。CPI與PPI中的部分項目會被納入PCE的計算。
對聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)而言，這些符合預期的數據可能讓其有更多空間維持利率不變，而不是升息，尤其是在周五公布疲弱就業報告之後。
利率市場也反映出這項預期。CME FedWatch工具顯示，CPI公布後，市場預期9月維持利率不變的機率從54%升至62%。
荷姆茲海峽緊張持續 布油徘徊90美元
目光轉向中東，油價周三震盪，市場持續受到各方對荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)不同說法的影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨一度短暫觸及每桶90美元。
目前看來，重新開放這條重要水道的和平協議進展有限，美國與伊朗仍持續宣稱掌握這條重要航道的控制權。
美國總統川普在Truth Social上表示，「美國完全控制荷姆茲海峽。」
伊朗國營媒體周二稍早報導，伊朗再次提出要求，表示美國必須停止各條戰線上的敵對行動，並解凍遭凍結的資產，荷姆茲海峽才會重新開放。相關說法引述伊朗國家安全委員會主席Mohsen Rezaei向中國駐德黑蘭大使發表的言論。
據伊朗國營媒體，Rezaei表示，「在美國改變行為並接受伊朗的條件之前，荷姆茲海峽不會開放。任何伊朗與阿曼之間的航運協議，都是獨立於荷姆茲海峽關閉之外的另一件事。」
Kpler數據顯示，周二獲確認通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻數量小幅增加，但整體市場氣氛仍保持謹慎，加上新的攻擊事件進一步加劇擔憂。
葉門叛軍「青年運動」(Houthi)在曼德海峽(Mandeb Strait)攻擊商業航運，造成4名貨輪船員及2名葉門救援人員死亡。
日元持續回吐干預後漲幅
其他主要貨幣方面，日元兌美元走弱，持續回吐上月底華盛頓與東京進行歷史性聯合干預後取得漲幅。美元兌日元上漲0.1%，至159.46。
稍早公布的最新Reuters Tankan調查顯示，受強勁半導體需求及國內消費旺盛帶動，日本企業信心在8月有所改善。這項調查旨在提前反映日本央行(BoJ)季度企業短期經濟觀測調查的結果。
